content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes mobile equipment such as sweepers, mowers and tillage machines, not structural connectors, anchors or fasteners."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes ceiling panels and suspension grids, not structural connectors, anchors or fasteners, despite shared commercial construction customers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Makes roofing membranes, insulation and industrial brake components rather than structural connectors, anchors or fasteners."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Diversified across roof coatings, HVAC components and industrial valves; only specialty adhesives overlap with Simpson's lines."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to manufacturers; a materials business, not building connection products."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment, a different product category despite sharing residential and contractor customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Makes roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber composites, not structural connectors, anchors or fasteners."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes precision bearings for aerospace and industrial machinery, a different product set with different end customers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Core business is coatings, sealants and roofing systems; construction adhesives are only one line among consumer and industrial products."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes cement, ready-mix concrete and mortar, which are construction materials and inputs rather than connectors, anchors or fasteners."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes turf equipment, irrigation and underground construction machinery, a different equipment business from building connection products."}]}
